text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a strong four-day rally that has gained back most of last week's losses. The recovery tracks a broader rebound in oil prices—US crude is trading around $89.62 per barrel, up from the lows seen earlier this week—and follows fresh analyst attention on the stock on November 11th. The timing and direction suggest investors are rotating back into energy names as oil stabilizes.

However, the two-week picture remains underwater, and the fundamental headwinds are real: Russian crude production has rebounded sharply to 8.73 million barrels a day, pushing global oil markets back into surplus rather than the tight conditions that had supported prices. This supply rebalancing is the reason for the recent weakness and why today's bounce, while real, hasn't erased the month's decline.
